doc: Graph B of the storage design (10^5 entities, about 10^6 links over 6 kinds, the shape of urdr's benches/walk.rs) seeded into a running hub's schema-7 store in chunks (each short, so the hub's writer is never kept waiting), then graph/neighbors four hops out and in both directions from entity 1, 20 samples each (--perf records every sample, no budget; the design's reference is 21 to 56 ms). Both walks stop at the answer's cap (200 nodes, truncated: cap, nothing hidden): a sample times a capped walk, not every node four hops out.

sql: insert into entity (n, id, kind, origin, ver, created_tx, updated_tx) with recursive c(i) as (select 1 union all select i + 1 from c where i < 100000) select i, 'note:' || i, 'note', 'recorded', 1, 1, 1 from c

insert or ignore into link (src, kind, dst, origin, tx_from) with recursive c(i) as (select 1 union all select i + 1 from c where i < 100000) select (i * 2654435761) % 100000 + 1, 'k' || (i % 6), (i * 40503 + i / 7) % 100000 + 1, 'recorded', 1 from c
